releaseNotes: New Arabic OCR engine: PaddleOCR keeps text detection and English/digit recognition, while EasyOCR Arabic ONNX handles Arabic lines on-device. The Arabic model downloads once (~52 MB), is SHA-256 verified, then OCR remains local. Existing Smart Search content is preserved and arabic_repair_v4 retries prior Arabic repair attempts without clearing the main index. Tesseract has been removed from the production OCR path.
